label: EXPLORATORY_PILOT
research_question: Does the Track C Design A funding-trail QLIKE improvement (model E vs RV-only model A, originally mean delta_QLIKE = -0.3579 in session_20261118T093031Z) hold under an ALTERNATIVE chronological holdout (test month 2024-09, train 2024-04..08)?
entry_origin_rule: origin bar t eligible iff trailing 168h history present and next-24h horizon bars t+1..t+24 all inside the holdout test window; train origins use the same rule restricted to the train window
horizon: next-24h realized variance = sum of 24 hourly squared close-to-close log returns t+1..t+24
feature_causality: all features causal-at-t (trailing only); funding trails use strictly prior funding prints (bi < i)
model_family: stdlib OLS HAR (log-realized-variance), Duan smearing back-transformation
primary_metric: delta_QLIKE_vs_A (A_minus_E; negative = E worse, positive = E better)

bootstrap.unit: UTC-day block, resampled jointly across instruments

loio: leave-one-instrument-out mean delta QLIKE vs A

materiality_floor.loio_consistency: LOIO delta_QLIKE_vs_A positive for majority of held-out instruments

expected_outcome_interpretation: If E materially improves QLIKE under this alternative holdout with CI95 lower bound > 0, the Track C funding-trail result is robust to holdout choice (still EXPLORATORY/PILOT). If not, the original result is holdout-specific and must be reported as such.
